1//! zinc


2/*


3 * A small but representative Zinc library: globals, a struct with


4 * methods and an operator, loops of every kind, and an anonymous


5 * timer callback.


6 */


7library Counters requires optional TimerUtils {


8    constant integer MAX_COUNTERS = 8;


9    integer counters[MAX_COUNTERS];


10    real ratio = 0.5, scale = 2.0;


11


12    private {


13        string NAME = "Counters";


14    }


15


16    public struct Counter {


17        integer value = 0;


18        static integer created = 0;


19


20        static method create(integer start) -> thistype {


21            thistype c = thistype.allocate();


22            c.value = start;


23            thistype.created += 1;


24            return c;


25        }


26


27        method operator [] (integer i) -> integer {


28            return counters[i];


29        }


30


31        method bump() {


32            this.value += 1;


33        }


34    }


35


36    function IsEven(integer n) -> boolean {


37        return n % 2 == 0;


38    }


39


40    function SumCounters() -> integer {


41        integer i, total = 0;


42        for (0 <= i < MAX_COUNTERS) {


43            if (IsEven(i) && counters[i] != 0) {


44                total += counters[i];


45            } else if (i > 6) {


46                break;


47            }


48        }


49        return total;


50    }


51


52    function onInit() {


53        integer i = 0;


54        Counter c = Counter.create('hfoo');


55        while (i < MAX_COUNTERS) {


56            counters[i] = -i * 2;


57            i += 1;


58        }


59        do {


60            i -= 1;


61        } while (i > 0);


62        debug BJDebugMsg(NAME + ": " + I2S(SumCounters()));


63        c.bump();


64        TimerStart(CreateTimer(), ratio * scale, true, function() {


65            DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer());


66        });


67    }


68}


69//! endzinc
